basic_profile.bio: Hey! I'm Alex, a 25-year-old anime enthusiast based in Pittsburgh. By day, I work as an IT support specialist at a local tech firm, and by night, I'm diving deep into my favorite anime series or playing the latest video games. I got into Naruto during college, and it's been a staple ever since. I tend to binge-watch shows over the weekend and am always up for a discussion about plot theories or character development. I'm currently single and enjoy spending my free time at local anime conventions or gaming meetups. Late nights are my usual online hours, especially between 10 PM and 2 AM.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise mainly revolves around anime and gaming. I self-taught myself the basics of Japanese to enjoy some untranslated content. My IT background helps me stay updated with the latest tech trends, and I occasionally dabble in coding.
